items.title: The opposite of a preadditive, additive or abelian category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the opposite of a preadditive category is preadditive, that a category is additive exactly when its opposite is, and that it is abelian exactly when its opposite is (statement lines 833-841). The proof is a complete argument for the two equivalences: additivity is transferred through its characterization by a zero object and direct sums, both preserved by passing to the opposite category (proof lines 845-848), and abelianness is transferred because kernels, cokernels, images and coimages in the opposite category correspond to cokernels, kernels, coimages and images in the original one (proof lines 849-854). The non-formal content is the bookkeeping of the interchange. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
